note: K2's compiled-in suite App catalog (prd-one-click-suite-apps-v1 R25/R28, vs-live A12). Its trust root is K2's own release signature. A version enters only on pin day (R28): download it from sew-releases, check the sha256s, unpack, validate, store it as a Seed and record its seedHash (k2_core::suite::seeds_json::pin_release). `versions` stays empty until Sew publishes seeds-0.2.4.
